# VRChat Version
Since:
```
    VRChat Build: 2021.2.3p1-1102-c68323f231-Release
```
# Description of the bug
When opening up your Desktop via StemVR Overlay, the VRChat logfile gets spammed with `Error      -  <I> Failed to get cursor position:`, taking up about 480 lines of useless information **per second**.
# Steps to reproduce
1. Set the SteamVR version to v1.14 by going to `SteamVR` > `Properties` > `BETAS` > `linux_v1.14 - Older build, for Linux users`
2. Launch SteamVR
3. Run VRChat using Proton version 5.13-6 by going to `VRChat` > `Properties` > `COMPATIBILITY`, check the box that says "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool", and then select `Proton 5.13-6` from the dropdown list.
4. Launch VRChat in Steam VR Mode
5. (optional) monitor your logfile in realtime via `tail -f '~/AppData/LocalLow/VRChat/VRChat/output*'`.
6. Now, goto VRChat and push the menu button on your controller to bring up the SteamVR overlay. Then, click on "Desktop", which is the second icon from the left bottom corner of the menubar. 
7. Now the VRChat log is filled with:
```
2021.07.16 17:34:26 Error      -  <I> Failed to get cursor position:
処理は成功しました。
2021.07.16 17:34:26 Error      -  <I> Failed to get cursor position:
処理は成功しました。
2021.07.16 17:34:26 Error      -  <I> Failed to get cursor position:
処理は成功しました。
︙
```
for about 79 times per second. Multiply that by the 6 linespaces that it takes up, the logfile becomes bloated real quick.
